 Harry Potter reference. 
In the German translation of the Harry Potter books Hermoine is called Hermine. In "Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fires" Viktor Krum, Hermoine's boyfriend at the time, tries in vain to pronounce Hermoine's name correctly. In the German version he always says 'Ermine instead of Hermine.
